description: Accept a production-error signal — the operator approval that turns it into a governed INCIDENT under the company's KTLO program. The target codebase resolves from codebaseId → repo → the signal's service; if none resolves the call returns codebase_required. Requires `write` scope.

codebaseId.description: Target codebase id (preferred way to resolve the incident's repo).

repo.description: Target repo "owner/name" (used if codebaseId is omitted).

name: anyforge_accept_observability_signal
title: Accept observability signal
